services.desc: Our Durango fishing guides are highly professional and ensure a safe and instructional trip down either of these rivers. The Animas offers anglers hard fighting fish, seclusion, and beautiful views where the San Juan is an excellent shoulder season and winter fishery with 10,000-12,000 fish per mile. The San Juan is a classic tailwater that will ensure tactical fishing with the opportunity to shake hands with a giant. Join us in Southwest Colorado to make memories that will last a lifetime. The San Juan should be on every angler’s list of trout fisheries to visit. It can be fished 365 days a year and hosts thousands of fish per mile.
